## Description

docs/clinical-safety/: intended use, hazard log (wrong patient, missed allergy, wrong dose, lost result, unsigned note treated as signed, duplicate merge error, …) with severity/likelihood, mitigations tied to tests, residual risk and release sign-off template. Name the clinical safety reviewer who signs each release from P2 onward; define clinical incident review process.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Hazard log covers every P2 clinical feature with at least one mitigation linked to a test or control.
- [ ] **AC2.** A named clinical safety reviewer is recorded and signs the R2 release.
- [ ] **AC3.** Clinical incident review process (report → triage → fix → review) is documented and tested once with a tabletop exercise.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
